cause: steam-user's licenses carry the whole CMsgClientLicenseList.License message (time_next_process, minute_limit, minutes_used, payment_method, purchase_country_code, territory_code, change_number, initial/renewal period and unit, master_package_id). licenses_json (79-08) emits only package_id, time_created, owner_id, access_token, license_type and flags, the fields GameLib reads. The expected values for the omitted fields are synthetic placeholders.
